name: Negabinary Signed-to-Unsigned Map
description: Element-wise negabinary (base -2) encode/decode. Forward (TIn[] → TOut[]): maps signed integers to unsigned negabinary via (n + MASK) ^ MASK where MASK = 0xAAAA…. After differencing smooth data the high-order bits vanish faster than zigzag encoding, producing denser zero runs at high bit-planes when followed by BitshuffleStage + RZEStage. Inverse: (u ^ MASK) - MASK cast to signed. Size-preserving; lossless. When fusing difference + negabinary, prefer DifferenceStage<T, TOut> for a single-kernel pass.
